note: Brief 023 final (Waymark, 2026-10-19): engine 0.8.2 (crowd.pace per-walker leg pace, Pulse's clerk leave-stagger, car.drive with the service drive and serviceBay, Motive's rulings: fire ends with the final fight, car pace, S05 runs), Splice's district-wide walk grid with walkable pavements and the re-sited call boxes, site, cover, rounds and seats regenerated. Route changes: careless-reporter-not-stopped re-sited (the kill timed to guard 73's arrival, the first tick in reach, searched every 0.5 s by the composer's new step option 'every', on the square north of the Office; guard 64 finds him at 7:35.2 and radios it, landing after the Take: a win at Alert 2, 12 T in total against route B's 3 T; Aster accepted the radio reporter); route-g-kill and route-g-kill-board go in at 4:04, after guard 74 has walked past the service lane, so the escort is unseen (Alert 1, 7 T in total, Standing 3); block-spot re-sited to (77.25, -33.75), the drive cell where car.drive parks, its car across both pickup-camera lines (Aster: the solid block, blockMoveS 8 s kept), route-b-block and route-b-block-board recomposed. The escort Service lane to Getaway bay stays 64.6 m (46.2 s) on the final grid, as mission.json quotes.
